Theme

Computing & programming

debug verb and noun

also fix an error, fix a bug, correction

* our formation

* (our own formation) ēmendō, ēmendāre, ēmendāvī, ēmendātum

verb, first conjugation

correct or amend

Applied to fixing code. This covers correction generally; “debugging” can also include investigation before a fix exists.

Other words

  • ēmendātiō, ēmendātiōnis f. — correction

    noun, third declension · classical

  • * (our own formation) mendum ēmendāre — fix an error, fix a bug

    also used · * our formation

  • * (our own formation) vitium corrigere — fix a bug

    also used · * our formation

    An earlier alternative.

  • * (our own formation) ēmendātiō mendī — correction of a bug

    also used · * our formation

  • corrēctiō, corrēctiōnis f. — correction

    noun, third declension · also used · classical

See also bug, bug report.
